where: Pearlmoor Quay — the harbour town itself, home of the Tide Lumenary
mood: A waltz on wet boardwalks under a cyan moon — the lamplit harbour at night, nets mended, boats rocking, the whole quay humming along.
_note: Matches the classic anchor: 100 BPM, 3/4, F major, accordion-flavoured waltz carrying the lullaby's lift-and-settle shape. Unconditioned so the tempo holds at 100. Contrast: -b is the lonely D-minor 92 BPM outskirts, -c the quick 116 BPM festival; this is the town proper, warm and bustling at a mid stroll. | Re-roll 1: the first take read ~66/192 BPM on onset autocorrelation (a 6/8 lilt, off the 100 BPM brief) and its loop seam failed (0.468, reglue 0.498); tempo and metre restated.
core_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
3/4 waltz time at a moderate 100 BPM, three steady beats in every bar
sampled accordion-like reed lead carrying a warm lilting waltz melody
mandolin-style tremolo strumming the waltz chords
glockenspiel buoy-bells ringing on phrase ends
rocking oom-pah-pah waltz bass like a moored boat
a playful woodwind figure crying like gulls between phrases
soft brushed snare on the downbeat, the creak of the boardwalk
lamplit seaside harbour town at night, cosy, salt-aired and gently bustling

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {arriving on the quay: the oom-pah-pah bass and mandolin tremolo start rocking at once, a glockenspiel buoy-bell rings, a woodwind gull cries, and the accordion squeezes a pickup into the theme}
styles: waltz under way from the first beat

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the harbour waltz in F major on the accordion lead: a hopeful rising lift landing on the downbeat, settling home over beats two and three; warm, hummable, swaying like the boats}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the same waltz again, now with the woodwind answering each phrase like a gull and the glockenspiel buoy-bells chiming in the gaps, the mandolin tremolo a little fuller}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: a tender turn to D minor and B-flat major, the accordion sings longer notes over the dark water while the bass keeps rocking, then climbs back toward the home key}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the harbour waltz returns in F major, full and warm at the same steady 100 BPM; the last bar rocks straight back into the theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
